server.name: io.github.arzharch/pgops-mcp
server.description: Safe, audited PostgreSQL operations for AI agents: queries, migrations, EXPLAIN, containers
server.title: pgops

environmentVariables.description: PostgreSQL connection string for the database to operate on.
environmentVariables.name: PGOPS_DSN

environmentVariables.description: Optional separate DSN for the read-only pool. Use a role with no write grants to enforce read-only at the database rather than only in the server.
environmentVariables.name: PGOPS_READONLY_DSN

environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to withhold every mutating tool. Write tools are not registered at all, so an agent cannot call them.
environmentVariables.name: PGOPS_READ_ONLY

environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to register container.restart and container.exec. Off by default: Docker socket access is root-equivalent on the host.
environmentVariables.name: PGOPS_APPROVAL_MODE

environmentVariables.description: Path to the append-only JSONL audit log.
environmentVariables.name: PGOPS_AUDIT_LOG

environmentVariables.description: Statement timeout applied to every query unless a tool call overrides it.
environmentVariables.name: PGOPS_DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_MS

environmentVariables.description: Ceiling a caller-supplied timeout is clamped to.
environmentVariables.name: PGOPS_MAX_TIMEOUT_MS

environmentVariables.description: Rows returned by query.read when the caller does not specify a limit.
environmentVariables.name: PGOPS_DEFAULT_ROW_LIMIT

environmentVariables.description: PostgreSQL connection string. From inside a container, localhost is the container itself — use host.docker.internal or the compose service name.
environmentVariables.name: PGOPS_DSN

environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to withhold every mutating tool.
environmentVariables.name: PGOPS_READ_ONLY

environmentVariables.description: Path to the audit log inside the container. Mount a volume at this path or the log dies with the container.
environmentVariables.name: PGOPS_AUDIT_LOG
